title: Open-Meteo historical archive — Vielha grid point, 5–13 July 2015–2026
claims: The archive returned the grid point 42.7768 N, 0.7988 E at 967 m elevation for the 5–13 July window in each year from 2015 to 2026, a total of 108 days.
Daily maximum temperature over those 108 days ranged from 13.0 to 35.4 °C with a median of 24.3 °C; daily minimum ranged from 7.8 to 18.8 °C with a median of 14.5 °C.
Precipitation reached at least 1 mm on 53 of the 108 days and at least 5 mm on 19 days, with a maximum daily total of 25.1 mm.
The grid point is at 967 m, while the VDA track reaches 2,551 m, so the archive values do not represent conditions at the highest parts of the course.
